name: canvas
title: Design canvas
description: A set of designs laid out on a canvas, such as the steps of a wizard or variants of a screen. Pan and zoom, pin comments to any point or element, mark each frame approved or in need of changes, and approve the set or ask for changes.
use_when: You designed several screens, dialogs or steps of a flow (as HTML mockups or images) and need a person to look at them side by side, say what to change on each, and tell you which ones are done.

shortcuts.does: Comment: click a frame to pin a comment
Move: drag to pan the canvas
Close the comment being written, or stop commenting
